claims: In 2026, the ordinary retirement age in Spain is 66 years and 10 months for those who have contributed less than 38 years and 3 months.
In 2026, retirement in Spain is possible at 65 years if contributed 38 years and 3 months or more.
Starting in 2027, the general ordinary retirement age in Spain is 67 years.
Starting in 2027, retirement in Spain at 65 years is possible if at least 38 years and 6 months of contributions are accredited.
In Spain, at least 15 years of contributions are needed, with two of them within the last 15 years.
The full retirement age for US Social Security is 67 years for those born in 1960 or later.
Early retirement for US Social Security is available from 62 years with a permanent reduction in the benefit amount.
Delayed retirement for US Social Security increases the benefit up to 70 years.
